decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a rapid cross-axis shift around indices 488–495 involving coordinated N/E drop and U spike, possibly a jump or transient offset; (2) a prolonged quasi-stable interval in E/U from 610–625, ending with an abrupt E drop—suggesting a platform followed by a new motion onset. No clear opposing return is resolved in either case.

regions.observation: Abrupt multi-sample shift in N and E components around index 490–493: N drops from ~-1.9 to ~-2.1, E drops sharply from ~2.35 to ~0.78 over 2 samples, then recovers partially; U shows a corresponding spike. The shape suggests a possible transient offset or jump with incomplete return.

Extended plateau-like behavior in E and U from ~610–622: E remains near -1.3 to -1.9, U stays elevated (~2.2–4.0), while N fluctuates moderately; this contrasts with earlier high-frequency variability and may indicate a sustained deformation phase or sensor artifact. A sharp drop in E at index 623 (to -3.7) initiates a new regime.
